search_text: published ZDI-22-323 ZDI-CAN-15119 Schneider Electric IGSS IGSSdataServer Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2022-02-11 CVE-2022-24316 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-24316 5.3 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N ['Schneider Electric'] ['IGSS'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Schneider Electric IGSS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSDataServer process, which listens on TCP port 12401 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the IGSSDataServer process. https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=SEVD-2022-039-01 https://www.cisa.gov/uscert/ics/advisories/icsa-22-046-01 ['2021-12-15 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-02-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2023-09-20 - Advisory Updated'] Vyacheslav Moskvin https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-323/
title: Schneider Electric IGSS IGSSdataServer Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Schneider Electric IGSS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSDataServer process, which listens on TCP port 12401 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper initialization of memory prior to accessing it. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the IGSSDataServer process.
